categories.main_business_segments: QB Net Holdings operates two main business segments: Domestic Business, which provides hair-cutting services in Japan through directly operated and franchised stores under brands such as QB HOUSE, QB PREMIUM, and FaSS; and Overseas Business, which offers similar hair-cutting services in international markets through directly operated stores, primarily under the QB HOUSE and QB PREMIUM brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operational model is a highly standardized, efficient, and quality-controlled hair-cutting service that eliminates unnecessary steps such as shampooing and coloring, focusing solely on haircuts. This model is supported by proprietary training programs (LogiCut Professional Stylist Schools), digitalization of customer data and feedback, and streamlined store operations, including the use of ticket vending machines and digital customer management tools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: QB Net Holdings primarily serves general consumers seeking quick, affordable, and reliable haircuts, targeting a broad demographic including working professionals, families, and individuals valuing time efficiency. Its main markets are urban and suburban locations with high foot traffic, such as train stations and shopping centers, both in Japan and overseas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in Japan and has expanded internationally to regions including Singapore, Hong Kong, Taiwan, the United States, Canada, Vietnam, and Malaysia. As of June 2025, it manages 724 stores, with 585 in Japan and 139 overseas, and continues to pursue further international growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: QB Net Holdings is positioned at the downstream end of the supply chain, directly providing end-consumer services through its own and franchised retail outlets. It controls the customer experience and service delivery, while also managing training and quality assurance internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focused on enhancing customer experience through digital transformation (DX), expanding overseas operations, strengthening human capital via training and improved working conditions, and optimizing operational efficiency. R&D is not a major focus, but innovation is pursued through IT investments, app development, and continuous improvement of service processes and training systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from direct hair-cutting service fees at company-operated stores, franchise royalties, and service fees from franchisees. Additional income streams include franchise registration fees and operational support fees, with most revenue recognized at the point of service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other quick-service hair salon chains and traditional full-service salons, both in Japan and overseas. QB Net Holdings differentiates itself as a market leader in the quick-cut segment, emphasizing scale, operational efficiency, and brand recognition, and has received multiple industry awards for service innovation and customer satisfaction.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending June 2025, the company reported consolidated revenue of 25.5 billion yen and net profit attributable to owners of 1.02 billion yen, with a workforce of 2,552 employees. The company has shown steady revenue growth (3.2% YoY), though operating profit declined due to upfront investments in overseas expansion and digital transformation. The medium-term plan targets continued top-line growth and margin recovery as overseas operations scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: QB Net Holdings offers a unique value proposition of fast, affordable, and consistent-quality haircuts, eliminating unnecessary services to maximize customer convenience and time savings. Its strong brand, standardized service, extensive training system, and commitment to sustainability (e.g., resource-saving operations) further differentiate it from traditional salons and other quick-cut competitors.
